title: The History of John Bull
author: John Arbuthnot
description: "The History of John Bull" by John Arbuthnot is a satirical allegory written during the early 18th century.
longDescription: The text humorously portrays the character of John Bull as a representation of the English people, describing him as a straightforward but often gullible tradesman grappling with the complexities of politics and social interactions in his era.

authorInfo.bio: John Arbuthnot (1667–1735) wrote The History of John Bull. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
